import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_86/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_86/training_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Perform join on ['fname', 'day'] as per operation history
df_joined = pd.merge(df0, df1, how='inner', on=['fname', 'day'])

# Group by 'fname' from Source2_86_0 and count occurrences of 'fname' in Source2_86_0 as 'row_count'
# Since after join, 'fname' is unique per row, count rows per fname in df0 before join
# But operation history shows group by on Source2_86_0.fname after join, so we group on df_joined['fname']
target_df = df_joined.groupby('fname', as_index=False).size().rename(columns={'size': 'row_count'})

# Ensure correct column types: 'fname' as string, 'row_count' as integer
target_df['fname'] = target_df['fname'].astype(str)
target_df['row_count'] = target_df['row_count'].astype(int)

# Write the result to the specified path
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_86/target_multisource.csv"
target_df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source files with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_86/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_86/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on 'fname' and 'day' columns (inner join to keep only matching rows)
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, how='inner', left_on=['fname', 'day'], right_on=['fname', 'day'])

# Group by 'fname' and count occurrences to get 'row_count'
result = joined.groupby('fname', as_index=False).agg(row_count=('fname', 'count'))

# Write output with exact target schema and column names
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_86/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
